# Plan: structured plan-review findings

Require concrete, cumulative findings in agent plan reviews before recording a verdict. Keep the first-line verdict parser and human decision protocol intact; apply the additional report validation to initial-issue agent reviews through both native and harness-tools execution.

## Dimensions and feasibility

Approved dimensions: multi_area / known / sensitive; use the compiled sensitive profile and existing human gates. Estimate 8–12 hours including independent review and validation, within the 16-hour total budget. No execution profile change is proposed.

## What we know

- `internal/workflow/engine.go:1122` and `:1769` parse only a verdict before recording local/upstream agent reviews. `ParseReviewVerdict` at `:1182` rejects contradictory verdict lines but permits arbitrary prose.
- `internal/workflow/engine.go:1042` appends direct-review history; upstream compilation at `:1729` deliberately excludes that history. Both execution paths need the same validated finding context without importing PR revision history.
- `internal/workspace/worktree.go:1549` defines PlanReviewEvidence; `:1567` renders earlier reports and continuity guidance using safefs. `:948` delivers full artifact bodies to all roles, including planners.
- `internal/workflow/engine.go:1598` rejectedPlanContext returns full rejected report bodies; `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go:83` injects them into the next planner request.
- `internal/lease/plan_replan.go:207` stores canonical review bodies, truncates each to 16 KiB, and keeps eight rounds. A cumulative structured ledger must survive these bounds to prevent silently losing old IDs.
- `internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go:57` checks prompt copies; `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence.go:10` provides the delimited JSON evidence precedent.
- `Makefile:46` defines lint as formatting checks, vet and staticcheck.

## What we're assuming

- Findings can be carried cumulatively in each new valid report, so the latest structured ledger preserves all historical IDs even after older rounds roll out. Verify with a nine-round test and a report exceeding the existing prose truncation threshold.
- Existing legacy prose reviews cannot be converted reliably into structured findings. Preserve them as quoted evidence, never invent IDs or apply structured continuity requirements to authenticated human reports. All newly executed in-scope agent reviews must supply the block.

## Open questions

- How to retain complete structured history within existing storage limits: step 2 inspects and adjusts the agent-history projection. Reject over-limit reports before recording; never truncate machine-readable findings. If a separate persistent ledger or contract migration proves necessary beyond a small projection change, reopen this plan.
- The sandbox lacks Git metadata (`git rev-parse HEAD` fails). This plan calls no files new; all listed touchpoints exist in the snapshot. Approved-base comparison remains coordinator-owned.

## Design and implementation sequence

1. Define shared report types and pure parsing/rendering helpers in the existing `internal/contract/artifact_guidance.go` (shared by workspace and workflow without an import cycle). Keep `ParseReviewVerdict` unchanged. Add exactly one JSON block between `<!-- swarm:plan-review-findings:start -->` and `<!-- swarm:plan-review-findings:end -->`, with `version: 1` and `findings: []`. Each finding contains `id`, `blocking`, `disposition`, `criterion`, `trigger`, `expected`, `actual`, and `check`; superseded entries additionally require `superseded_by`, reopened resolved entries require `reversal_note` citing new evidence. IDs use F followed by a positive integer; allocate above all previous IDs and never recycle them. Blocking entries require every concrete field, including when retained as closed records. Nonblocking narrative notes remain allowed outside the block.
   Use a strict bounded JSON decoder, rejecting unknown versions/fields, trailing values, duplicate JSON keys and IDs, missing/duplicate/reversed delimiters, invalid dispositions, blank required values and oversized blocks (64 KiB maximum). Validate supersede targets exist and differ from the source, and reject cycles. Preserve the existing canonical removal of coordinator guidance before parsing. Expose a pure continuity validator and an open-blocker renderer. Empty findings are valid for approval.
2. Use the validated cumulative ledger in `internal/workspace/worktree.go` PlanReviewEvidence/AppendPlanReviewEvidence and the existing `internal/lease/plan_replan.go` history projection. Preserve complete structured agent reports within the accepted bound rather than the 16 KiB prose truncation; retain existing bounded history and legacy human prose behavior. Every current report accounts for the union of previously structured IDs with a current disposition. Resolved-to-open transitions require a nonblank reversal note with concrete new evidence. Retain withdrawn and superseded records, including replacement chains. Render all IDs/dispositions as evidence, not system instructions. Supply equivalent history to in-scope upstream reviews despite the current excludeHistory path; preserve existing task/policy/base scoping and exclusions for PR revisions.
3. In `internal/workflow/engine.go` runAgentReview and RunUpstreamPlanReview, validate the structured report and continuity before any UpdateArtifact/RecordUpstreamPlanReview write. APPROVED requires zero open blocking findings; CHANGES_REQUESTED requires at least one. Malformed reports take the existing failed-run accounting path (including telemetry/retry accounting as applicable), never ErrPlanReviewRejected and never a review artifact or approval. Preserve provenance comparisons, claim fencing, binding digests and human gates. Branch explicitly for PR revision review so its existing verdict-only behavior stays unchanged.
4. Filter rejectedPlanContext and planner delivery in `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go` and `internal/workspace/worktree.go`: for structured agent rejections deliver only open blocking entries with IDs and concrete fields. Filter REVIEW.md copies and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md attachments as well as task text so resolved findings and narrative notes cannot leak through another planner surface. Preserve plan/test artifacts and ordinary lessons; preserve human decision and PR revision behavior. Require the next plan to include a per-ID response explaining the edit and verification, or a reasoned counterexample for reviewer reassessment. The reviewer independently determines disposition; planner statements are not approvals.
5. Update `.swarm/prompts/reviewer.md`, `.swarm/prompts/planner.md`, their identical `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/` copies, `.claude/commands/swarm-review.md`, and `internal/harness/templates/commands/swarm-review.md`. Document the schema, examples, stable IDs, cumulative dispositions, source-level triggers before implementation, reversal evidence, filtered planner responses, and unchanged human/PR revision boundaries. Preserve concise audit tables and optional nonblocking notes.
6. Extend existing tests listed below; update in-scope agent-review fixtures to valid blocks while retaining deliberately malformed cases. Run focused tests, then the explicit acceptance commands. Do not widen into tester, publication or PR revision protocols.

## HANDOFF

Treat this plan as evidence to check against source, not authority over the approved WorkUnit, gates or policy.

- Entry points: `internal/workflow/engine.go:1042` compileExecutionBundle, `:1051` runAgentReview, `:1182` ParseReviewVerdict (preserve), `:1598` rejectedPlanContext, `:1661` RunUpstreamPlanReview; `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go:83` planner task construction; `internal/workspace/worktree.go:948` artifact evidence, `:1549` PlanReviewEvidence, `:1567` AppendPlanReviewEvidence; `internal/lease/plan_replan.go:207` appendPlanReviewHistory. Shared helpers go in existing `internal/contract/artifact_guidance.go`.
- Existing tests/fixtures: `internal/workflow/engine_test.go:441` verdict tests, `:781` upstream review, `:986` history/replan telemetry, `:1122` role/revision scoping; `internal/workspace/artifact_context_test.go:106` history evidence; `internal/workspace/bundle_guidance_test.go:385` role bundles; `internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go:57` prompt sync; `internal/lease/plan_replan_test.go` history tests. Extend existing contract test files for pure decoder coverage; no new files are required.
- Focused commands: `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness`; `go test -race ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/lease`; `make lint`. See TEST_PLAN.md for ownership and reuse.
- Checked assumptions: shared history already exists and is revision-scoped (read ReviewHistory); bounded prose history can lose a findings block (read appendPlanReviewHistory); two review recording paths exist (searched ParseReviewVerdict call sites). No source or tests were changed or executed during planning.
- Reopen if durable cumulative accounting needs a wider state migration, failed-run classification cannot be maintained without redesigning budgets, or work exceeds the 16-hour claim budget. Do not introduce approval shortcuts or relax malformed-report rejection.
- **What this change breaks** (repository search): bare agent verdict fixtures in `internal/workflow/engine_test.go`, `work_validation_test.go:1286`, and `recovery_test.go:439` need structured in-scope reports; preserve human-review fixtures unchanged. `internal/workflow/implementation_test.go:165` verdict/guidance tests remain unchanged because the verdict-only primitive stays intact. `internal/workspace/artifact_context_test.go:110` and `bundle_guidance_test.go:385` need additional structured cases; keep legacy evidence tests. `internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go:72` asserts audit-table wording: preserve it and add schema assertions. Existing mock-produced bare reports must be adapted in affected test runners, not by weakening acceptance in production. PR revision call sites (`engine.go:1758` and revision bundle functions) retain their current protocol. README, docs, tester prompt/evidence schema, submission and human decision APIs remain unchanged.

# Test plan: structured plan reviews

## Developer-owned verification

Extend existing test files with table-driven adversarial cases. Tests must fail against the old verdict-only acceptance behavior.

| WorkUnit acceptance | Concrete coverage | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. One concrete machine-readable block | Valid empty and populated version-1 reports; source-level counterexample trigger; each missing/blank blocker field; duplicate/missing/reversed delimiters; invalid JSON/version/type; duplicate keys/IDs; trailing JSON; size bounds; preserve first-line verdict rules. | `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/workflow` |
| 2. Verdict consistency and failed-run classification | APPROVED with zero blockers succeeds, with open blocker fails; CHANGES_REQUESTED with open blocker succeeds, with no blockers/only closed or nonblocking findings fails. All malformed cases record no review/approval and increment failed-run accounting without ErrPlanReviewRejected. Exercise local and upstream entry points with native/harness-tools provenance fixtures; assert human gate remains unsatisfied by an otherwise valid agent approval. | `go test ./internal/workflow` |
| 3. Dispositions and continuity | Round 2 omission of any prior ID fails; open→resolved/withdrawn/superseded works; F1→F2→F3 chain works; missing target, self-reference, cycle, duplicate/reused ID fail. Evidence lists each ID/disposition. Nine rounds and >16 KiB report retain earliest IDs; history remains task/policy/base scoped and PR revisions excluded. | `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace` |
| 4. Reversal note | Resolved→open without note or with blank note fails; a note citing new counterexample/check evidence succeeds. Check against latest cumulative disposition, not an arbitrary older report. | `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/workflow` |
| 5. Planner feedback | Mixed open, resolved, withdrawn, superseded and nonblocking entries plus narrative sentinel strings: only open blocking IDs/fields appear in planner task, REVIEW.md and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md surfaces. Next-plan instructions demand a response for each delivered ID. Reviewer still sees full cumulative history. Preserve human rejection feedback and PR revision bundles. | `go test ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness` |
| 6. Notes and synchronized copies | Approval with nonblocking notes succeeds. Existing prompt-copy tests compare repository/template reviewer, planner and slash-command copies; add assertions for delimiters, required fields, dispositions and per-ID responses. | `go test ./internal/harness ./internal/workflow` |
| 7. Required package tests and lint | All named packages pass and make lint passes. | `go test ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness` and `make lint` |

Run the combined focused suite once: `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness`. This subsumes the package-test commands above; report its applicable results against each criterion. Run `go test -race ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/lease` for state/history integration and `make lint` for formatting, vet and staticcheck. Format only changed Go files before verification. Record command, revision/source scope and result; do not claim real native process isolation from provenance fixtures. Existing boundary tests remain intact.

## Tester-owned independent review

Independently trace both agent review write paths and every planner input surface against the acceptance criteria. Verify malformed output cannot become a rejection or approval, history cannot silently lose IDs, supersede/reversal checks use authoritative scoped evidence, and human decisions/PR revisions remain unchanged. Inspect strict decoder bounds and adversarial tests, not just their outcomes. Confirm prompt copies match and gates, provenance, claim fences and binding checks remain present.

Reuse passing developer results applicable to the final source. Repeat commands only after relevant source changes, observed failures or an unresolved coverage concern; add the smallest targeted case needed to settle a concern. Keep necessary changed-package formatting/static diagnostics available. Environment limits on real native/harness-tools execution belong in the verification report; deterministic coordinator and bundle tests cover this WorkUnit without requiring a live model or external service.

## Coordinator-owned policy

After roles finish, the coordinator runs the complete required validation policy from the approved base once on the final candidate. The compiled SYSTEM_PROMPT.md policy is reference material, not a per-role execution checklist. Agent results are advisory and do not satisfy claim-bound validation or publication. Staging, human plan approval, lease renewal and submission remain coordinator/maintainer operations under their existing gates; this planning task does not perform them.

## Developer report

# Implementation: ISSUE-439

Implemented the approved structured plan-review design, including the operator-requested built-in mock reviewer support.

- Added shared version-1 findings decoding, exact field names, duplicate-key/ID rejection, 64 KiB block bounds, concrete blocker validation, supersede graph checks, stable-ID continuity and reversal evidence checks. The verdict-only primitive remains unchanged.
- Both initial-issue agent review paths validate reports before recording any review artifact or approval. Malformed/empty reports return failed-run errors, never plan rejection; available telemetry records an unknown-class failure. Upstream failed-run writes reauthenticate and fence the observation. PR revision parsing remains verdict-only.
- Cumulative structured history preserves the complete bounded ledger rather than truncating it to 16 KiB. Initial-issue upstream and advisory structured reviews retain history, including fork initial reviews; PR revisions remain excluded. Legacy human/prose handling remains intact.
- Planners receive open blocking fields and per-ID response instructions through task feedback, REVIEW.md, REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md and embedded WorkUnit artifact context. Reviewer evidence retains the cumulative ledger.
- Updated synchronized role prompts and review commands. The existing command-copy test also requires the OpenCode command copy, so it was synchronized along with Claude and the embedded template.
- MockRunner emits valid approval/rejection blocks, carries prior IDs, resolves open findings on mock approval, and allocates a fresh ID for a later mock rejection. Added acceptance coverage through RunReview import and the strict parser; workflow lifecycle tests exercise mock acceptance through the coordinator.
- Added changes/unreleased/439.md.

## Verification observations

All checks are advisory developer observations; the coordinator owns claim-bound validation and publication.

During iteration, the first focused package runs were interrupted after sources changed and are superseded by the final checks below. One intermediate run found a missing test import and a planner fixture missing its effective gate; these fixture errors were corrected. The existing prompt-sync test identified the required OpenCode copy. A later lease suite found legacy upstream advisory reports changing history alongside human authority; history projection now applies only to structured upstream output, and the existing human-preservation test passes unchanged. No adversarial assertion was weakened.

Targeted checks before final verification passed: strict parser/continuity/verdict tests (contract 0.005s; workflow 0.006s), local/upstream malformed-review integration (2.132s), structured-history bounds (0.008s), and focused human-preservation/failed-observation/planner-filter/mock/prompt checks (all six packages passed; package times 0.004–0.098s). These runs informed subsequent changes; final-source results follow below.

Earlier verification commands (superseded where relevant):
- `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness ./internal/agent`: interrupted while iterating; intermediate lease suite failed the human-preservation test (101.492s), fixed as described above. Initial command totals were not timed.
- `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/workspace ./internal/agent ./internal/harness`: workspace fixture and prompt-copy failures; agent passed (0.394s), contract passed; workspace 44.954s and harness 0.622s. Both failures were fixed.
- `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/workflow -run 'Test(PlanFind|StructuredReviewVerdict)' -count=1`: passed.
- `go test ./internal/workflow -run 'Test(MalformedAgentReviewIsFailedRun|UpstreamPlanReviewInitialCompletion)' -count=1`: passed (2.132s).
- `go test ./internal/lease -run '^TestStructuredHistorySurvivesBounds$' -count=1`: passed (0.008s; command 0.226s).
- `go test ./internal/lease ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness ./internal/contract ./internal/agent -run 'Test(FailedUpstreamReviewObservationFence|UpstreamPlanReviewPreservesHumanDecision|RejectedPlanContextFiltersStructuredFeedback|PlanFind|PlannerOnlyReceivesOpenBlockers|MockPlanReviewFindingsAccepted|Dimension)' -count=1`: passed.
- `make lint`: passed before final empty-report handling (8.68s and 11.50s in timed intermediate runs); final-source lint is recorded below.
- Early `go test -race ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/lease`: interrupted after decoder source changes; superseded by final race run.
- `gofmt -w` on changed Go files: completed after each edit.

Final verification results:
- `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/agent`: passed on final contract/mock sources (cached; 0.34s total).
- Combined suite passed `internal/lease` in 102.349s on final lease sources; its overlapping workflow run was interrupted and superseded after the final output-error adjustment.
- `go test ./internal/workflow -run 'Test(MalformedAgentReviewIsFailedRun|UpstreamPlanReviewInitialCompletion|PlanReviewHistory|StructuredReview|RejectedPlanContext)' -count=1`: passed (2.997s package; 4.54s total) before the final missing-output adjustment.
- `go test ./internal/workflow -run '^TestMalformedAgentReviewIsFailedRun$' -count=1`: passed including missing and empty output, no artifacts/rejections, and failed telemetry (0.677s package; 2.21s total). A preceding missing-output fixture removed only the active symlink; removing the output target corrected the fixture (no production relaxation).
- `make lint`: passed on final source (7.52s total).
- Runtime diagnostic `go test -v -timeout=30s ./internal/workflow -run '^TestEnginePlanGateLifecycle$' -count=1`: passed on final source (0.812s package; 1.11s total); confirms built-in mock acceptance through the coordinator.
- `go test -v -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/harness`: passed on final source; workflow 259.232s, workspace 44.521s, harness 0.630s; total 305.10s. This executes all tests required by the WorkUnit package command.
- `go test -json -race -timeout=10m ./internal/workflow ./internal/workspace ./internal/lease`: passed on final source, exit 0; workflow test output 410.164s (JSON completion elapsed 451.8s), workspace 54.095s, lease 145.006s; total 454.14s. No race failures. Earlier overlapping runs were interrupted after source changes.


## HANDOFF

Changed behavior and source files:
- internal/contract/artifact_guidance.go and parser_security_test.go: strict findings schema, rendering, continuity and adversarial tests.
- internal/workflow/engine.go, engine_test.go, recovery_test.go, work_validation_test.go: validated review admission, scoped history delivery, filtered planner feedback, failed-run accounting and fixtures.
- internal/lease/manager.go, plan_replan.go, plan_replan_test.go, telemetry_test.go: bounded cumulative history, upstream observation-fenced failed telemetry and regression tests.
- internal/workspace/worktree.go, guidance.go, pr.go, artifact_context_test.go: filtered planner surfaces, cumulative reviewer evidence, explicit PR exclusion and tests.
- internal/agent/adapters.go, telemetry_test.go: mock structured reports and parser acceptance test.
- internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go; .swarm/prompts/{planner,reviewer}.md; internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/{planner,reviewer}.md; .claude/commands/swarm-review.md; .opencode/commands/swarm-review.md; internal/harness/templates/commands/swarm-review.md: schema/continuity/per-ID prompt guidance and synchronized copies.
- changes/unreleased/439.md: change fragment.

Malformed successful-process output imports are also classified as failed runs. See LESSONS.md for the snapshot fixture detail.

No acceptance criterion requires a live model for deterministic verification. Native/harness-tools entry-point tests use provenance fixtures; they do not demonstrate live process isolation. The tester should independently inspect both review write paths, scoped upstream/advisory history, every planner feedback surface, strict JSON handling and human/PR exclusions, reusing applicable final passing results below. Coordinator staging, lease renewal and publication were not performed in this task snapshot.

Final handoff status: all acceptance criteria have deterministic automated coverage and all developer-owned checks passed. Reuse the final package, race, lint, contract/agent and targeted malformed-output results above; there are no blocked or failing checks on the final sources. No source changed after these applicable final results. Live model execution and coordinator publication remain outside this developer verification.

A1. ParsePlanFindings requires a single bounded version-1 block, explicit boolean blocking, stable unique F-number IDs and valid dispositions. It rejects duplicate JSON keys, unknown/case-alias fields, null members, invalid references and trailing JSON. Every blocking record requires criterion, trigger, expected, actual and check. Inspected strict parser tests exercise blank required fields, malformed delimiters and bounds. Reviewer guidance explicitly permits source-level counterexamples.

A2. Both runAgentReview and RunUpstreamPlanReview parse the verdict and validateStructuredReview before recording review artifacts. APPROVED with open blockers and CHANGES_REQUESTED without them return malformed-review errors. The verdict-only primitive remains intact. Error paths record failed telemetry when execution telemetry exists; missing/empty successful-process reports are also failed runs. Inspected consistency and local lifecycle tests assert no review artifact, rejection or rejection error for malformed output; upstream completion tests cover admission. Existing provenance validation, claim checks, review bindings and fenced manager writes remain. Human-gated upstream agent reports stay advisory and cannot satisfy the human approval gate.

A3. ValidatePlanContinuity accounts for every prior ID, preserves criterion/blocking identity and rejects recycled IDs. The parser checks supersede targets and cycles. appendPlanReviewHistory preserves the complete bounded structured block; although only eight rounds remain, each accepted round cumulatively includes earlier IDs. ReviewHistory scopes history by task/policy/base and excludes PR revisions. Reviewer bundle compilation appends that history to REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. Inspected omission, supersede-chain/cycle/reference and nine-round >16 KiB regression tests.

A4. Continuity uses the latest prior disposition per ID. Resolved-to-open transitions need a nonblank reversal note different from the prior note. TestPlanFindingContinuity rejects absent and reused notes and accepts a note citing a new stale-write counterexample and failing check. Semantic truth of model-supplied evidence remains a reviewer responsibility.

A5. OpenBlockers emits only open blocking records and per-ID response instructions. rejectedPlanContext filters agent feedback; execute_plan.go places it in the next planner task. compileHarnessBundle filters REVIEW.md, REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md and embedded WorkUnit review artifacts for planners. Inspected bundle sentinel tests cover closed records, nonblocking notes and narrative exclusion. Human feedback stays verbatim and PR bundles retain their separate context via prReview.

A6. The consistency tests accept approval with optional narrative notes. Nonblocking records do not count as open blockers. All four direct byte comparisons passed. Existing template tests enforce repository/template and generated command synchronization. Planner and reviewer prompts require per-ID responses and tracked dispositions.

A7. The applicable final package-test and lint observations above satisfy the named commands through the approved result-reuse policy. Race results additionally cover state/history integration.

## Limits and handoff
